note: id2label and preprocessing values are copied from the base model's config.json and preprocessor_config.json on Hugging Face (see hf_config_source.json / preprocessor_config.json in this directory for the verbatim downloads). The ONNX graph input is [batch, 3, 224, 224] float32 (NCHW), so normalization happens here: pixel/255, then (x - mean) / std.
